passes: Production BottomSheet tracks a held downward drag and returns below the 120 pt threshold
Upward and horizontal header movement do not take over or dismiss the sheet
A second header drag interrupts the return spring from its current position without snapping
A qualifying drag calls the controlled owner exactly once and closes through visible state
Reduced motion returns the denied drag directly
Production LogScreen keeps the opt-in editor usable across the target viewport and text matrix
Clean LogScreen editor accepts drag close with no write
Keyboard-height proxy remains scrollable; cancelled header touch resets, restores focus, and preserves the draft
Dirty drag preserves the draft, routes to the existing discard prompt and writes nothing
Dirty drag keeps the draft until explicit discard; an open prompt is not replaced and discard writes nothing
Pending, failed and unsure states deny drag closure while preserving draft, recovery and write count
The existing Log add-event sheet remains on the legacy opt-out path

focusProbe.note: RN Web focus was restored after cancelled header drag; native keyboard/focus behavior is not established by this browser check.
